description_expanded:
This beautiful and spacious three-bedroom residence is ideally located near the heart of Alys Beach, just steps from Fire Pit Park and within easy walking distance of the town center and the Caliza Pool Complex. Beach access is equally convenient, with a scenic stroll along the Sea Garden pathway leading directly to the Gulf. The first level of the home features a spacious private courtyard with a pool, creating a serene and inviting outdoor retreat. Inside, guests are welcomed into an open and airy great room offering comfortable seating, a dedicated dining area, and a beautifully appointed kitchen with a large center island, perfect for family gathering and entertaining. The primary suite is also located on the first floor and features a king-size bed and an elegant en-suite bathroom with a soaking tub. This suite offers direct access to both the courtyard and the parking court, adding to its comfort and convenience. On the second level, guests will find the two remaining bedrooms. The first bedroom, located at the top of the stairs, includes a queen-size bed and a private en-suite bathroom. The third bedroom is detached from the main house and is accessed via a covered balcony overlooking the courtyard and pool. It also features a queen-size bed and en-suite bathroom, providing a peaceful and private retreat. The second-floor terrace offers a wonderful space to relax and enjoy the Florida weather, complete with views overlooking the pedestrian pathway. This property has two designated parking spaces steps away from the home in the Seven Wells Parking Court. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, the Silva Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.

Primary Bedroom

1 King

Guest Bedroom #1

1 Queen

Guest Bedroom #2

1 Queen
